epics.title: Standalone Responsive Knowledge Base & Fast Search Tool
epics.jtbd: When an educational resident, researcher, or faculty member accesses the CRIE knowledge base on desktop or mobile, I want a fast, thoughtful, self-contained search and document exploration interface without third-party integration friction, so that I can immediately find and inspect clinical, academic, and normative resources in seconds.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Visual styling and layout fidelity compliance >= 99.5% against approved mockup
epics.tocConstraintRef: Frontend template styling and responsive viewport presentation
requirements: R1: Implement the approved design mockup (design/approved/20261117054021-mockup/mockup.html) pixel-perfect into the existing frontend codebase across mobile and desktop viewports without adding new architectural layers.

slices.title: Apply Approved Mockup Design to Existing Frontend
slices.jtbd: When implementing the approved mockup for this epic, I want to update the existing frontend layout and styling to match design/approved/20261117054021-mockup/mockup.html, so that the knowledge base interface adheres pixel-perfect to the approved design.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the approved mockup at design/approved/20261117054021-mockup/mockup.html
When the existing frontend styles and templates are updated
Then the visual layout, typography, color palette, and spacing match the approved mockup on 375px mobile and 1440px desktop viewports
Given user interactions with the updated UI components
When searching, filtering, and navigating documents
Then existing functionality and test suites remain intact without visual or behavioral regressions
slices.tocConstraintRef: Existing frontend UI template layout synchronization
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Visual diff discrepancy <= 0.1% against approved mockup
